cards.title: gunplay demo: range on security deck C-2
cards.body:
the first slice from the README: nail how the guns feel before anything else gets built on top.

- [x] the Mk 23 standard issue, built off FOR/AGAINST's Glock frame
- [x] ammo types in mags: FMJ, AP, hollow point, frangible, incendiary, shock, subsonic, tracer
- [x] found guns from the FOR/AGAINST armory: M4A1, AK-74M, SIG MPX, MWS 6.5, Benelli M4
- [x] simulated rounds: muzzle speed, drop, drag
- [x] recoil: Tarkov pull-down + Halo recovery
- [x] ADS onto the real optic, proper 4x scope picture
- [x] procedural viewmodel: sway, bob, springs, reloads, casings
- [x] diegetic UI: ammo on the gun, stats board over the lanes
- [x] targets: zoned mannequins, armored, mover, gongs, security drone

cards.title: decide the slice after the gunplay demo
cards.body: SHELLS is now a tactical FPS survival horror on a dead colony ship (you're a security guard). the README stops at the gun range.
